Zapier NPM Account Compromise (Shai Hulud V2)

Target: zapier-npm
Repository: https://github.com/zapier/zapier-platform
Date: 2025-11-24
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft/Self-Propagation
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Shai Hulud self-propagating worm compromised Zapier's NPM account, publishing malicious versions of core packages (e.g., zapier-platform-cli, zapier-platform-core). The malware uses TruffleHog to harvest NPM tokens, GitHub PATs, and cloud keys, publicly leaking them into thousands of GitHub repositories titled 'Shai Hulud: The Second Coming' to rapidly propagate.

Compromised Versions

  • 18.0.2
  • 18.0.3
  • 18.0.4
